items.description:
Hello all - 

 

We look forward to seeing for you for Wrestling with Tradition, taught by Rabbi Rachael Houser.

 

The class starts next Wednesday, February 18. It will meet on Wednesday evenings, from 7:00 - 8:45 pm, in room 804 in the Community House at 123 E 55th Street. 

 

We'll provide dinner each week during class. 

 

The final class is April 22 and there's no class on April 8. We'll also have a Shabbat dinner on March 27. I'll send reminders of all of these dates! 

 

Warmly, 

Jane Doe

Hello all - 

 

We look forward to seeing for you for Wrestling with Tradition, taught by Rabbi Rachael Houser.

 

The class starts next Wednesday, February 18. It will meet on Wednesday evenings, from 7:00 - 8:45 pm, in room 804 in the Community House at 123 E 55th Street. 

 

We'll provide dinner each week during class. 

 

The final class is April 22 and there's no class on April 8. We'll also have a Shabbat dinner on March 27. I'll send reminders of all of these dates! 

 

Warmly, 

Jane Doe

Hello all - 

 

We look forward to seeing for you for Wrestling with Tradition, taught by Rabbi Rachael Houser.

 

The class starts next Wednesday, February 18. It will meet on Wednesday evenings, from 7:00 - 8:45 pm, in room 804 in the Community House at 123 E 55th Street. 

 

We'll provide dinner each week during class. 

 

The final class is April 22 and there's no class on April 8. We'll also have a Shabbat dinner on March 27. I'll send reminders of all of these dates! 

 

Warmly, 

Jane Doe
